title: libssh2:x86-windows-static build fails

labels.name: category:vcpkg-bug
labels.description: The issue is with the vcpkg system (including helper scripts in `scripts/cmake/`)

labels.name: requires:repro
labels.description: The issue is not currently repro-able

body:
Tried installing `libcurl:x86-windows-static` and it failed during this. This is on Windows 10 build 15063.

```-- Configuring x86-windows-static-rel
CMake Error at scripts/cmake/vcpkg_execute_required_process.cmake:14 (message):
    Command failed: D:/Dev/vcpkg/downloads/cmake-3.8.0-rc1-win32-x86/bin/cmake.exe;D:/Dev/vcpkg/buildtrees/libssh2/src/libssh2-1.8.0;-DBUILD_EXAMPLES=OFF;-DBUILD_TESTING=OFF;-DENABLE_ZLIB_COMPRESSION=ON;-DBUILD_SHARED_LIBS=OFF;-DCMAKE_CXX_FLAGS= /DWIN32 /D_WINDOWS /W3 /utf-8 /GR /EHsc /MP;-DCMAKE_C_FLAGS= /DWIN32 /D_WINDOWS /W3 /utf-8 /MP;-DCMAKE_EXPORT_NO_PACKAGE_REGISTRY=ON;-DCMAKE_FIND_PACKAGE_NO_PACKAGE_REGISTRY=ON;-DCMAKE_FIND_PACKAGE_NO_SYSTEM_PACKAGE_REGISTRY=ON;-DCMAKE_INSTALL_SYSTEM_RUNTIME_LIBS_SKIP=TRUE;-DCMAKE_VERBOSE_MAKEFILE=ON;-DVCPKG_APPLOCAL_DEPS=OFF;-DCMAKE_TOOLCHAIN_FILE=D:/Dev/vcpkg/scripts/buildsystems/vcpkg.cmake;-DCMAKE_ERROR_ON_ABSOLUTE_INSTALL_DESTINATION=ON;-DCMAKE_CXX_FLAGS_RELEASE=/MT /O2 /Oi /Gy /DNDEBUG /Zi;-DCMAKE_C_FLAGS_RELEASE=/MT /O2 /Oi /Gy /DNDEBUG /Zi;-DCMAKE_SHARED_LINKER_FLAGS_RELEASE=/DEBUG /INCREMENTAL:NO /OPT:REF /OPT:ICF;-DCMAKE_EXE_LINKER_FLAGS_RELEASE=/DEBUG /INCREMENTAL:NO /OPT:REF /OPT:ICF;-G;Visual Studio 15 2017;-DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release;-DCMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX=D:/Dev/vcpkg/packages/libssh2_x86-windows-static
    Working Directory: D:/Dev/vcpkg/buildtrees/libssh2/x86-windows-static-rel
    See logs for more information:
      D:\Dev\vcpkg\buildtrees\libssh2\config-x86-windows-static-rel-out.log
      D:\Dev\vcpkg\buildtrees\libssh2\config-x86-windows-static-rel-err.log

Call Stack (most recent call first):
  scripts/cmake/vcpkg_configure_cmake.cmake:99 (vcpkg_execute_required_process)
  ports/libssh2/portfile.cmake:14 (vcpkg_configure_cmake)
  scripts/ports.cmake:73 (include)


Error: Building package libssh2:x86-windows-static failed with: BUILD_FAILED
Please ensure you're using the latest portfiles with `.\vcpkg update`, then
submit an issue at https://github.com/Microsoft/vcpkg/issues including:
  Package: libssh2:x86-windows-static
  Vcpkg version: 0.0.78-490ba941ef8b1ef4bb6061a7eeafdcb20dee6bad
```

And this is err.log:
```CMake Error at D:/Dev/vcpkg/downloads/cmake-3.8.0-rc1-win32-x86/share/cmake-3.8/Modules/FindPackageHandleStandardArgs.cmake:137 (message):
  Could NOT find ZLIB (missing: ZLIB_LIBRARY ZLIB_INCLUDE_DIR)
Call Stack (most recent call first):
  D:/Dev/vcpkg/downloads/cmake-3.8.0-rc1-win32-x86/share/cmake-3.8/Modules/FindPackageHandleStandardArgs.cmake:377 (_FPHSA_FAILURE_MESSAGE)
  D:/Dev/vcpkg/downloads/cmake-3.8.0-rc1-win32-x86/share/cmake-3.8/Modules/FindZLIB.cmake:112 (FIND_PACKAGE_HANDLE_STANDARD_ARGS)
  src/CMakeLists.txt:239 (find_package)
```

`zlib:x86-windows-static` was successfully installed during the install of curl.
